name: handoff
description: Asks the agent for a resume handoff before the context is compacted, compacts, then points it back at the handoff.

thresholdPercent.title: Handoff threshold (%)
thresholdPercent.description: How full the context window gets before the agent is asked to write a handoff.

autoCompact.title: Compact and resume automatically
autoCompact.description: Once the handoff is written and the turn ends, compact and send a resume prompt. Off: the agent tells you and you compact.
